name: cyrius-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for the Cyrius language toolchain — currently the cyrius-lsp language-server wiring; future Cyrius-related Claude Code extensions land here. Sibling repo to MacCracken/cyrius (the language).

plugins.name: cyrius-lsp
plugins.description: Cyrius language server (cyrius-lsp) wired to all .cyr-family extensions (.cyr / .tcyr / .bcyr / .fcyr / .scyr / .smcyr). Diagnostics from cc5; future capabilities (hover, goToDefinition, semantic tokens) land in cyrius-lsp itself.
